examples.en: I went on an excursion recently.
We went on an excursion to the seaside.
examples.zh: 我们去海边远足了一次。

examples.en: The conductor forgot to put me off.
The conductor told me where to get off.
examples.zh: 售票员告诉我在哪里下车。

examples.en: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view.
examples.zh: 我坐在汽车前部以便看风景。

examples.en: The view from the hill is beautiful.
I love travelling in the countryside.
I realized that I was the only passenger.
examples.zh: 我意识到车上只剩下我一个乘客了。

examples.en: I realized with a shock that I was alone.
examples.zh: 我吃惊地发现只剩我一个人了。

examples.en: I was the only passenger left on the bus.
examples.zh: 我是车上剩下的唯一乘客。

examples.en: My trip took longer than I expected.
I prefer to stay on the bus.

words.meaning: n. 伍德福德格林（地名）

examples.en: I was going to Woodford Green.
I do not like losing my way.
He lost his way in the forest.
I sat in the front of the bus.
My trip took me longer than I expected.
In that case, I will stay on the bus.
examples.zh: 那样的话，我就留在车上。

sentences.en: I love travelling in the country, but I do not like losing my way.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在乡间旅行，但不喜欢迷路。

sentences.en: I got on the bus and told the conductor that I was going to Woodford Green.
sentences.zh: 我上了公共汽车，告诉售票员我要去伍德福德格林。

sentences.en: He answered that he would tell me where to get off.
sentences.zh: 他回答说他会告诉我在哪里下车。

sentences.en: The conductor said that this was as far as the bus went.
sentences.zh: 售票员说汽车就开到这里为止。

sentences.en: I asked if this was Woodford Green.
sentences.zh: 我问这是不是伍德福德格林。

sentences.en: It did not matter, because the bus was going back and I preferred to stay on it.
sentences.zh: 没关系，因为汽车要往回开了，我宁愿留在车上。

article.en: I love travelling in the country, but I do not like losing my way.
article.zh: 我喜欢在乡间旅行，但不喜欢迷路。

article.en: I went on an excursion recently, but my trip took me longer than I expected.
article.zh: 最近我去远足了一次，但旅途比我想象的要长。

article.en: I got on the bus and told the conductor that I was going to Woodford Green.
article.zh: 我上了公共汽车，告诉售票员我要去伍德福德格林。

article.en: He answered that he would tell me where to get off.
article.zh: 他回答说他会告诉我在哪里下车。

article.en: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
article.zh: 我坐在汽车的前部，以便欣赏乡村的景色。

article.en: Looking round, I realized with a shock that I was the only passenger left on the bus.
article.zh: 我环顾四周，吃惊地发现车上只剩下我一个乘客了。

article.en: The conductor said that this was as far as the bus went.
article.zh: 售票员说汽车就开到这里为止。

article.en: I asked if this was Woodford Green.
article.zh: 我问这是不是伍德福德格林。

article.en: Oh dear, he had forgotten to put me off!
It did not matter, because the bus was going back and I preferred to stay on it.
article.zh: 没关系，因为汽车要往回开了，我宁愿留在车上。
